summary: Machine Learning Developer and Researcher specializing in Computer Vision, graduating in Computer Science and participating in the Graduate Program in Informatics (PPGIA / PUCPR) as a visiting master's student. Experienced in building applied Artificial Intelligence solutions including Computer Vision systems, LLMs, intelligent agents, and enterprise automations. Currently working as an ML Developer at DATAKIE leading technical and architectural decisions for the ML pipeline, while conducting academic research (PIBIC / CNPq / PUCPR) on domain adaptation, autoencoders, and deep architectures.
goals: To research and build state-of-the-art solutions in Computer Vision and Artificial Intelligence, uniting rigorous scientific experimentation with scalable, high-impact production pipelines.
